provenance.definition: Share of external public debt owed to private creditors (bondholders, banks), amount-weighted across each region. The remainder is owed to official bilateral lenders (including China) and multilateral institutions. High private share = exposure to market runs; high official share = exposure to slow, fragmented restructuring.
provenance.attribution: UN Trade and Development (UNCTAD) — A World of Debt 2025
